evidence.quote: I would like this morning to discuss the importance of more thoroughly involving markets and the public in the financial regulatory system.
Most importantly, there should be a clear expectation that the shareholders and creditors of the failing firm will bear losses to the fullest extent consistent with preserving financial stability.
I think that regularizing both stress tests and the release of information relevant to them deserves serious consideration for at least two reasons.

parsed.rationale: The speech addresses financial regulatory reform, market discipline, resolution regimes and stress-test transparency, with no discussion of monetary policy, inflation or the macro outlook. It carries no monetary policy signal, so the stance is neutral.
